fields.summary_ko.0: SK hynix Inc (NASDAQ:SKHY) stock rose +3.8% in U.S. after-hours trading to $127.30, bolstered by NVIDIA's strong earnings.
fields.summary_ko.1: NVIDIA expanded its supply commitments from $27.9 billion to $39 billion, primarily through securing multi-year memory supply, reflecting increased AI infrastructure demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: As a key high-bandwidth-memory (HBM) supplier to NVIDIA, SK hynix benefits from improved future demand visibility and revenue stability enhancement through multi-year procurement contracts.
